name: GCP FinOps Advisor
description: Enterprise A2A v1.0 FinOps specialist that analyzes GCP Cloud Billing anomalies, BigQuery query efficiency, and safe cost-remediation plans.

skills.name: Cost Anomaly Triage
skills.description: Diagnose unexpected GCP Cloud Billing spend spikes by service, SKU, and project labels without making destructive changes.
examples: Why did BigQuery spend in acme-analytics jump 45% yesterday?
Triage the top 3 SKUs contributing to our weekly Cloud Billing alert.

skills.name: BigQuery Query Optimization
skills.description: Inspect BigQuery Standard SQL queries for full table scans, missing partition filters, and SELECT * anti-patterns, then propose safe rewrites.
examples: Optimize SELECT * FROM analytics.events for lower bytes scanned.
Estimate on-demand savings from adding a _PARTITIONDATE filter.
